question: Who is qualified to perform the installation of Caṇḍeśa in this manner?
premises: The Caṇḍeśa installation is prescribed in this way
A person may undertake this rite
Such a person is described as excellent among men
inference: The best among men is the one who performs the installation of Caṇḍeśa in this manner.
plain_english: The excellent man who performs the installation of Caṇḍeśa in this way is truly distinguished.
